items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: this old man, old man, Fee, not Fee, used to play with John Robichaud and Vic Gasson, all that was real.

ctx.x: And since it's Dixley and stuff come back here, it's the same kind of stuff that was playing down here years ago. Yeah, Ori is good on it. Ori knows all that. You understand? So that made him great and famous. But we had some trauma players here in New Orleans. George Fields, Eddie Atkins, and Dutray, Laura Dutray, and this old man, old man, Fee, not Fee, used to play with John Robichaud and Vic Gasson, all that was real. DeLeo,
